morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中按完整外来姓氏处理，不进行马来语词缀拆分。英语参考读音重音在第二音节；历史上的Mc并非马来语前缀。[Cambridge读音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/mccarthy)

senses.zh_definition: 麦卡锡：源自爱尔兰语的姓氏；具体指哪位人物，须由全名或上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An Irish-origin surname; the particular bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Ireland; individu yang dimaksudkan dikenal pasti melalui nama penuh atau konteks.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，即kata nama khas；不得仅凭姓氏认定为某位政治人物、作家或运动员。马来语释义为本条编写的说明，非DBP引文。搭配及例句为教学编写示例，未经语料频率验证。[姓氏资料](https://www.libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/macc/mac-carthaigh.php)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Nama keluarga McCarthy hendaklah dieja mengikut dokumen pengenalan diri pemohon.

dual_scenarios.en: The surname McCarthy must be spelled as it appears on the applicant's identification document.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menyemak maklumat itu; nama keluarganya ialah McCarthy.
dual_scenarios.en: I've checked; their surname is McCarthy.

etymology.historical_story: McCarthy is an English rendering of the Irish surname Mac Cárthaigh, traditionally interpreted as 'son of Cárthach'. Cárthach is an old personal name associated with loving. The spelling therefore preserves a family relationship from Irish naming history. In Malay, however, it functions as an intact surname rather than a locally derived word. [Surname source](https://www.libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/macc/mac-carthaigh.php)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住McCarthy是“人的姓”，不是动作词；把Mc联想到爱尔兰姓氏中历史上的“某人之子”，但不要当作马来语词缀。
